title: VC-JCS Envelope Verifier
description: Offline verifier for W3C VC 2.0 Data Integrity exports over did:key, covering both eddsa-jcs-2022 (Ed25519) and ecdsa-jcs-2019 (P-256, vendored sha256-pinned @noble/curves 2.4.0). Decodes the did:key verificationMethod directly to key bytes, recomputes the JCS-canonicalized proof hash and verifies the signature, shows the exact canonical bytes the signature covers, and independently recomputes every embedded execution_hash from its policy_parameters/output_payload — never trusting either the proof or the execution_hash fields as stated in the pasted document. Zero network calls anywhere in the tool.

export_document.description: A VC-JCS-wrapped export JSON (mandate/artifact plus a root-level proof block)

verification_report.description: verdict, signature check, per-receipt execution_hash recompute results, attestation_grade and signing-identity class
